content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the JSCPS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of JSCPS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JSCPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Jharkhand State Child Protection Society recruitment is 15th October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the JSCPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for the Social Worker Member / Chairperson / Member posts in the Jharkhand State Child Protection Society recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts under JSCPS Recruitment 2026 is 35 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for JSCPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the JSCPS Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Social Worker Member and Chairperson/Member positions will receive an honorarium of Rs. 2000 per sitting.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Social Worker Member post?
faq.answer: For the Social Worker Member post, candidates need a degree with at least seven years of experience in child-related fields like education, health, protection, or welfare, or be a practicing professional with a degree in child psychology, psychiatry, sociology, or law.

faq.question: Q7. Can retired judicial officers apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, retired judicial officers are eligible to apply for the Chairperson/Member, Child Welfare Committee post, provided they meet the other specified criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JSCPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of application forms, evaluation by a selection committee, personal interaction, and assessment of educational qualifications and work experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for the JSCPS posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in the JSCPS Recruitment 2026 is 60 years. Candidates should not exceed this age limit to be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the JSCPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of JSCPS. The application link and further instructions will be available in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
